title: add-alert-adjudicator-invocation-importance-and-cost-provenance
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: alert noise and duplicate SLO triggers have been a major operational cost during capacity events; teams need a deterministic way to prioritize alerts by invocation importance and attach token-cost provenance for downstream billing and RCA. This PR implements an Alert Adjudicator service that ingests existing SLO/alert signals and sampled invocation traces to compute an invocation importance score (IIS) and then tags alerts with a provenance token_cost_export_id that links to a compact provenance export. Changes: 1) new microservice observability/alert_adjudicator that subscribes to alert events and sampled traces, computes IIS using a lightweight heuristics model (weighting token-cost, SLO breach severity, recent run-rate, and caller priority), and emits adjudicated_alert events; 2) provenance exporter observability/cost_provenance_exporter that materializes token-level cost provenance for adjudicated alerts into a compressed NDJSON export for billing/forensics; 3) dashboard updates grafana/dashboards/alert-adjudicator.json with a prioritization heatmap and top-10 provenance-linked incidents; 4) API: new /v1/adjudicate and /v1/provenance endpoints in observability-api to query adjudications and fetch exports; 5) alert-router integration that allows automatic quieting/rerouting based on IIS and configurable thresholds. Backwards compatibility: Adjudicator respects existing alert lifecycle and is opt-in per-tenant via feature flags. Rollout plan: staged rollout to internal tenants then to 10 pilot customers; default behavior is no-op until enabled. Checklist: feature-flagged; unit/integration tests added; e2e replay harness with synthetic incidents included; docs PR will follow for public API. Impact: expected reduction of alert noise by 40% in pilot; no breaking changes. Linear: ENG-4123 (adjudicator core), ENG-4205 (provenance export schema).

release_notes: Adds an opt-in alert adjudication service that prioritizes alerts by invocation importance and produces token-cost provenance exports for adjudicated incidents. Feature-flagged and off by default. Provides new API endpoints /v1/adjudicate and /v1/provenance and a Grafana prioritization heatmap.
perf_impact: low; adjudication path is asynchronous and uses existing sampled traces; added an in-memory LRU for recent invocation scores to avoid repeated compute; measured <2% additional CPU for observability workers at pilot load
migration_notes: Configuration: enable feature flag observability.adjudicator.enabled per-tenant. Export storage: provenance exports are written to the existing telemetry-exports S3 bucket under provenance/YYYY-MM-DD/tenant-id. No automatic data migration required.
notes_for_sre: Monitor adjudicator.processing.latency and adjudicator.queue.depth. Watch provenance.export.rate and set tenant export quotas if necessary. Default retention for exports is 30d; can be configured per-tenant. Run the included replay harness to validate tenant behavior before enabling in production.
